headline: Nigeria business activity growth slows in October
summary: Nigeria's business activity expanded at a slower pace in October 2026, with the Current Business Performance Index falling to 115.4 points. Firms cited power supply issues, limited credit access, and inadequate infrastructure as primary constraints.
why: The Nigerian Economic Summit Group (NESG) index provides insight into the health of Africa's largest economy. Persistent infrastructure and credit challenges are key indicators for investors in the region.
